title: MapDef

ambience_asset_key.description: Ambience loop (ambience.*), played under the music.

grid_file.description: File name of the logic grid in content/maps/, e.g. starter_town.grid.json. A content file name, not an asset path.

x.description: Column, counted from the west edge.

y.description: Row, counted from the north edge.

respawn.description: Where a player who dies on this map comes back (a walkable cell of this map's grid). Optional: without it the player returns to the first warp of any map that arrives here, then to the new_character start (balance.yaml).

description: Map metadata (ARCHITECTURE §5.3). The logic grid (cells, spawns, warps, NPCs, zones) is a separate generated file named by GridFile; it is not a definition.
